sentences.en: Give me the metal bucket with the oil in it.
sentences.zh: 给我那个装有油的金属桶。

sentences.en: The philosopher's stone could transmute every precious metal into gold.
sentences.zh: 哲学家石可以将任何贵重金属变成黄金。

sentences.en: Lithium, sodium, potassium, rubidium, caesium and francium are alkali metals.
sentences.zh: 锂、钠、钾、铷、铯和钫都是碱土金属。
